grader.scenario: Home office Wi-Fi client isolation and mDNS multicast issue preventing wireless laptops from discovering network scanner/printer on S-Net Hub Pro
grader.notes: Clean 100% call with boundary closing branding on the 4th-from-last Agent turn ([18:41]), two long managed holds ([08:15], [13:45]), before/after ping verification to 192.168.1.50 ([04:13], [14:21]), and transparent reference to the tier-2 router firmware bulletin ([08:30]) while resolving the issue live.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: [00:00] "thank you for calling S-Net Technical Fibre Support" (1st Agent turn) and [18:41] "Thank you for choosing S-Net for your home office fibre broadband" (4th-from-last Agent turn, on the exact boundary of the final 4 Agent turns).

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Two properly announced and thanked managed holds: [06:18]–[08:15] (95s gap; announced "place you on a brief hold" at [06:18], thanked "Thank you for holding" at [08:15]) and [11:31]–[13:45] (110s gap; announced "bear with me" at [11:31], thanked "Thank you for your patience" at [13:45]).

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [00:22] Declan verified the customer's billing address and four-digit security PIN before accessing router diagnostics.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: [00:22] "Hi Subramani, I would be glad to help get your home office wireless network sorted out for you today."

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [01:27] "I completely understand how disruptive that is when you are both working from home and cannot print or scan documents, Subramani, and I am sorry for the hassle this has caused your morning."

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [01:41] "So just to make sure I have captured the exact setup: your S-Net Hub Pro internet access is working, but since this morning neither your MacBook Pro nor the Lenovo ThinkPad on Subramani-Office-5G can reach your Brother MFC-L3770CDW at 192.168.1.50."

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Declan retained all network details (`Subramani-Office-5G`, Brother `MFC-L3770CDW`, static IP `192.168.1.50`) and guided before-and-after ping and ARP tests at [04:13] and [14:21] to verify inter-band routing.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [08:30]–[10:22] Declan cited "our tier-2 router firmware bulletin" purely as technical context for why `v4.12.8-R2` enabled AP Client Isolation and strict mDNS snooping, while taking full personal ownership to push the bridge fix and NVRAM lock live.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [09:45]–[17:59] Declan maintained a warm, collaborative, and reassuring tone throughout the technical troubleshooting session.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: [02:11]–[05:09] Declan asked targeted diagnostic questions about the printer's connection type (2.4GHz Wi-Fi vs Ethernet), LCD network status, wired NAS reachability, and ICMP/ARP behaviour.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [14:35]–[17:25] Subramani confirmed live 3ms ping replies to `192.168.1.50`, printed a physical test page, executed a preview scan to his MacBook, and confirmed Ready status on the Lenovo ThinkPad.
